comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and verifies damping behavior; record installs two hook-in gondola brackets at a marked level and seats a shelf across them.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key insertion, setscrew release, fine rotary tuning, counterhold, retightening, and response-based iteration. Record requires pitched hook-and-tongue insertion, swing-to-seat motion, two separate bracket placements, and bimanual shelf carrying/seating.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe impact cycles within 12 mm plus a post-lock drift test. Record requires both released brackets geometrically engaged in level-3 slots and a released, stable shelf within tight pose tolerances, with drop, tilt, or premature shelf-motion failures.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both involve precise insertion and seating, but gondola hook engagement and bimanual load placement do not test tool-mediated calibration, tightening torque, or iterative dynamic-response control. Candidate omits numeric drift, rebound, overload, and torque thresholds; these do not erase the meaningful distinction.
